# Vendored mqtt.js

- Package: mqtt@5.15.2 (MIT license)
- Source: https://unpkg.com/mqtt@5.15.2/dist/mqtt.min.js
- Vendored so the board simulator (and the debug console) work from file://
  without CDN availability.
- Keep in sync with `debug-console/vendor/mqtt.min.js`; both directories must
  stay self-contained with the same version.
